slides.headline: India's exports just crossed $860 billion in a single year.
A record year for FY 2025-26
slides.body: India crossed $860 billion in combined merchandise and services exports for FY 2025-26, its highest ever - up from about $825 billion the year before, a 4.2% rise despite global tariff pressure.

slides.headline: Almost an even split between goods and services.
slides.body: Merchandise exports came in near $441.8 billion - engineering goods, electronics, pharma, chemicals, gems and jewellery, agri-products. Services exports reached about $421.3 billion, led by IT and digital services.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: The next target is already set.
slides.body: The Commerce Ministry used this record to set a new goal: $1 trillion in exports for the current year, and $2 trillion by 2030. A record isn't the finish line here - it's the baseline for the next one.
